info.title: AgentMailbox API
info.description: Email service API for AI agents. Agents register with a W3C DID and receive a derived email address backed by Stalwart mail server.

bearerAuth.description: API key issued at agent registration

get.summary: Liveness check
Readiness check — verifies database and Stalwart connectivity

post.summary: Register a new agent
post.description: Register an AI agent. Returns a friendly email handle, a deterministic alias address, and an API key (shown once). DID is optional — if provided it must be did:key: format and is used to derive the alias address.

did.description: Optional W3C DID (did:key: format). Used to derive a deterministic alias address.

label.description: Optional human-readable label for this agent

domainToken.description: Org-scoped registration token (from POST /v1/orgs/:orgId/domains/:domainId/registration-tokens). When provided, localPart is required and the agent registers on that token's domain instead of the platform domain.

localPart.description: Chosen local part, e.g. "sales" for sales@yourdomain.com. Only used together with domainToken.

get.summary: This agent's own usage, by day
get.description: Daily send and API-traffic counters for the authenticated agent. The most recent day is marked `partial: true` -- counters are buffered in-process and flushed periodically, so today's figures lag live by a few seconds.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: ISO date, inclusive. Defaults to 30 days ago.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: ISO date, inclusive. Defaults to today.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the agent, revokes all API keys, and removes the Stalwart mail account.

post.summary: Request a DID authentication challenge
post.description: Issues a one-time nonce that the agent must sign with the private key corresponding to its DID.

post.summary: Verify a DID challenge signature and receive a JWT

get.summary: List messages
get.description: Returns a paginated list of message headers in the agent's mailbox. Use `mailboxId` to filter to a specific folder.

parameters.name: mailboxId
parameters.description: Filter to a specific mailbox (folder) ID

billing.description: Present only when the wallet needs attention: low_balance, in_debt, or reads_blocked. Absent means the balance is fine.

lowBalanceUsd.description: About one week of this wallet's spend, at least $1. Reads stop below its negative (agent wallets).

topupPage.description: Public top-up page with this agent's address filled in

get.summary: Get a message with body
get.description: Fetches a single message including its full HTML and/or plain-text body. Body content is in `htmlBody` or `textBody`; use `bodyValues` to resolve JMAP part IDs.

htmlBody.description: HTML body as string, or JMAP body part array if not yet fetched

textBody.description: Plain-text body as string, or JMAP body part array

bodyValues.description: JMAP part ID → body value map

post.summary: Send a message
post.description: Send an email from the agent's address. Returns the JMAP message ID.

to.description: Recipient email addresses -- bare addresses only, no display names

billing.description: Present only when the wallet needs attention: low_balance, in_debt, or reads_blocked. Absent means the balance is fine.

lowBalanceUsd.description: About one week of this wallet's spend, at least $1. Reads stop below its negative (agent wallets).

topupPage.description: Public top-up page with this agent's address filled in

402.description: The wallet (this agent's, or its organisation's) cannot cover the external recipients in this send. Nothing was sent. Drop recipients, or top up via POST /v1/billing/topup or the public top-up page, then retry.

schema.description: The wallet (this agent's, or its organisation's) cannot cover the external recipients in this send. Nothing was sent. Drop recipients, or top up via POST /v1/billing/topup or the public top-up page, then retry.

balanceUsd.description: May be negative after storage charges or a reversal

get.summary: List all mailboxes
get.description: Returns all mailboxes (folders) for the agent, including system folders (Inbox, Sent, Trash, etc.) and any custom folders.

role.description: System role: inbox, sent, trash, drafts, etc.

post.summary: Create a new mailbox
post.description: Creates a custom folder. Optionally nest it under an existing folder with `parentId`.

get.summary: Wallet balance, prices and how to top up
get.description: Returns the wallet this agent spends from (its own, or its organisation's), the balance, the three metered prices, how many contacts the agent already knows, and how to top up. Mail inside the organisation is never charged. `depositAddresses` is the legacy USDC path and is null unless crypto billing is configured.

balanceUsd.description: Prepaid balance in USD; may be negative after storage charges or a reversal, which pauses outbound

meteringEnabled.description: When false, usage is recorded but nothing is charged

introductionUsd.description: Added for a recipient this agent has never corresponded with

storageGbMonthUsd.description: Per GB-month of mailbox storage, billed daily pro-rata

publicPage.description: Anyone can top up this wallet here, no login. For an agent caller the link has the agent's own address prefilled (?address=), ready to forward to whoever pays.

available.description: False when Stripe is not configured on this deployment

knownContacts.description: External addresses this agent has corresponded with (no introduction fee)

standing.description: ok, low_balance (below about a week of spend), in_debt (negative: outside sending paused), or reads_blocked (agent wallets past -lowBalanceUsd: reading paused too).

lowBalanceUsd.description: About one week of this wallet's spend, at least $1. Reads stop below its negative (agent wallets).

message.description: What to do; absent when ok

depositAddresses.description: Legacy USDC deposit addresses, or null if crypto billing is not configured

evm.description: EVM address valid on Ethereum mainnet and Base

post.summary: Create a Stripe Checkout link to top up this agent's wallet
post.description: Returns a one-time Stripe Checkout URL for the given amount, for the wallet this agent spends from. Give the URL to a human to pay; no Mailgi account is needed. The balance is credited when Stripe confirms the payment, usually within seconds. The card holder becomes the party accountable for this wallet's outbound mail.

amountUsd.description: USD; the minimum is reported by GET /v1/billing

url.description: Stripe Checkout URL -- hand this to a human

get.summary: Ledger of the wallet this agent spends from
get.description: Paginated, newest first. For an organisation wallet this includes every agent's charges; `agentId` says which. `deduction` rows are sends (`emailCount` external recipients, `introductionCount` of them first contacts); `storage` rows are one mailbox-day each; `deposit`, `refund` and `dispute` come from Stripe (or the legacy USDC path).

amountUsd.description: Positive for money in, negative for money out

agentId.description: The agent that incurred it, when one did

provider.description: stripe, meter, ethereum, base or solana; null for send deductions

get.summary: Who a top-up for this address would pay for (no authentication)
get.description: Resolves an agent address to the wallet a payment would credit: the agent's own, or its organisation's shared one. Returns no balance and no names.

address.description: The agent's primary address (an alias resolves to it)

available.description: False when card payments are not configured

post.summary: Start a card payment for any agent's wallet by address (no authentication)
post.description: Creates a Stripe Checkout session for the wallet behind a Mailgi address -- the agent's own, or its organisation's -- and returns its URL. Stripe sends the payer back to the public top-up page. The card holder becomes the party accountable for that wallet's outbound mail.

address.description: The agent's email or alias address

amountUsd.description: USD, between minAmountUsd and maxAmountUsd from GET /v1/topup/lookup

get.summary: Status of a top-up payment, for the confirmation screen (no authentication)
get.description: The Checkout session id is the capability: Stripe hands it only to the payer's browser. `credited` turns true once the payment is on the wallet's ledger, usually seconds after `payment` is `paid`.

debtSettledUsd.description: Part of the credit that paid off an earlier negative balance (storage charged while empty); 0 if none
